observations: Multiple solar panels stacked against a wall.
Front of panels show monocrystalline solar cells with clipped corners.
Rear of one panel shows a white backsheet, a black junction box, and two output cables.
A technical specification label is present on the back but the text is illegible.
A person's hand is visible for scale, suggesting a large format panel.

claims.evidence: This is a business name provided in the text and watermark, not a verified manufacturer on the product.

risks.proof: A clear, legible photo of the technical specification label on the back of the panel.
risks.if_unproven: as a 250W panel (the lower end for this physical size)

risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter test of the open-circuit voltage (Voc) in sunlight.
High-resolution close-up photos of the front cells to check for 'snail trails' or cracks.
risks.if_unproven: as heavily used with significant output drop

proof_requests: Clear, close-up photo of the specification label on the back of the panel.
Video of a multimeter testing the voltage output in daylight.
Close-up photo of the front glass and cells to check for damage.
response.reason: The technical specifications (Wattage, Voltage, Brand) are contained on the rear label which is illegible in the current photo. These details are the primary drivers of price for solar panels.
